The plan does not depend on the answer: the fix handles a failed review attempt of any reason. The test models the failure with `runs.clear()` (`dispatch/tests/support/mod.rs:690`), which the existing test at `first_slice.rs:3817` already uses.
10	- **"Take an issue through plan and review; at finalize answer `revise`."** Matches the code. The cause is `review_subject` (`scheduler.rs:10534-10548`), which filters `AttemptState::Complete` and so skips the Failed `review/1`.

14	
15	No change. `Attempt.artifacts["plan"]` of the failed `review/1` already holds the revised copy's path, and `Attempt.revisions` already holds the owner's round. `RECORD_VERSION` stays as it is in `dispatch/src/store.rs:26` (28 today); no bump. `SCHEMA_VERSION` in `src/core/model.rs:12` (16 today) is untouched.
16	
17	Which copy a rerun reads is derived, not stored, by one function, `rerun_copy` (below). It walks `t.attempts` backwards from the attempt being started (or shown), and the first of these decides. A `Complete` attempt of any stage with the subject artifact, as `review_subject` filters (`scheduler.rs:10534-10548`), ends the walk with no failed copy, so the rerun copies from it as today. A `Failed` workflow attempt of the same stage and context with the subject artifact, whose file exists, is the failed copy. Everything else, `Cancelled` included, is skipped. Position in the vector orders attempts across stages (`n` is per stage and cannot); the vector is chronological, which `review_subject`'s `.rev()` already relies on. 18

20	
21	None new. `shown` and `input` keep their rules, so the existing tests `dispatch/src/ticket.rs:1797` and `1827-1875` (a Failed or Cancelled review copy is not *the plan* going forward) stand. 22

25	No new action or effect. Three edits in `dispatch/src/scheduler.rs`:
26	
27	1. **One helper `rerun_copy(t, stage, ctx, subject, before: usize) -> Option<PathBuf>`** next to `review_subject` (10534). `before` is the index in `t.attempts` of the attempt being started or shown (`t.attempts.len()` when it is not pushed yet), so the new attempt can never find itself. It does not use `latest_attempt` (9444), which looks at one stage only and, run after the attempt exists, would return that attempt. `Cancelled` is skipped on purpose: a parked or discarded review's copy is not the plan going forward (`ticket.rs:1856-1864`).
28	2. **`start_workflow` (7465-7472).** Keep `review_subject` for the session: `(source_path, source_session)`. 44	- `dispatch/src/main.rs:896-908` `print_lane_files`: after `(reviewed copy…, review open)`, print `    started from the revised copy of a failed attempt: <path>`. The owner's `plan.feedback-<n>.md` sits beside that path.
45	
46	The earlier attempt's rounds are not merged into `plan_rounds` (`serve.rs:564-572`): round numbers restart in each run and would collide in `PlanRoundView.n`. Follow-up if wanted.
47

49	
50	- `dispatch/tests/first_slice.rs`, one new test next to `3257`: `at_finalize`, `revise` with a note (as `3442`), overwrite `review/1`'s copy with marked text to stand in for the app's in-place edit, set `sb().runs.clear()`, `step` to the `review run gone` failure, assert the `rerun` question contains `review/1/joined/plan.md`, answer `rerun`.
